total_model.summary: Model projects 47.8 total points (NYJ 24, LV 24). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.8), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.7), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
